question: A series LCR circuit is connected to an AC source. If $X_L > X_C$, predict whether the circuit behaves more like an inductive circuit or a capacitive circuit. Give reason.

options.A: The circuit behaves as capacitive because $X_L>X_C$, so current leads the voltage.
options.B: The circuit behaves as inductive because $X_L-X_C>0$; the inductive effect dominates and current lags the applied voltage.
options.C: The circuit is at resonance because $X_L>X_C$.
options.D: The circuit is purely resistive because the reactances cancel.
